votes.evidence_summary: search with strictGroupSize=true and groupSize=2 returns 15 results instead of enforcing exactly 2 results per group, violating the strict grouping semantics
votes.rationale: the strictGroupSize parameter should enforce that each group contains exactly groupSize results, but the system returns 15 total results when configured for 2 per group with 5 categories, violating the documented constraint on group size enforcement
